title: New Structural Form of a Tetranuclear Lanthanide Hydroxo Cluster: Dy4 Analogue Display Slow Magnetic Relaxation

material_class.structural_family: tetranuclear lanthanide hydroxo cluster with ladder-type fused Tb2O2 rings

synthesis.procedure: TbCl3·6H2O and H3L were taken in 30 mL methanol and stirred at room temperature for 10 min to give a clear solution. Et3N was added dropwise and stirring continued for 24 h at room temperature. The solution was filtered and evaporated under vacuum to a solid yellow residue. X-ray quality crystals were grown from pyridine/benzene (5:1) with hexane as the diffusing solvent at room temperature in two weeks.
synthesis.time: stir 10 min then 24 h after base addition; crystals in two weeks
synthesis.vessel_or_method: ligand-controlled hydrolysis in methanol; crystallization by hexane diffusion into pyridine/benzene (5:1)
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: filtered, evaporated under vacuum to yellow residue; X-ray quality crystals from pyridine/benzene (5:1) with hexane diffusion at room temperature over two weeks

properties.summary: DC susceptibility of Tb4 is field-independent. χT = 49 cm3 K mol−1 at 300 K, decreasing to 29 cm3 K mol−1 below 50 K due to depopulation of Stark sublevels. Magnetization at 2 K and 5 T is 19 μB, below the expected saturation. No out-of-phase ac signal indicating slow relaxation was reported for Tb4.

measurements.name: χT
measurements.conditions: 300 K; dc fields 0.02 and 0.3 T; crushed crystals

material_class.structural_family: tetranuclear lanthanide hydroxo cluster with ladder-type fused Ln2O2 rings

synthesis.procedure: DyCl3·6H2O and H3L were taken in 30 mL methanol and stirred at room temperature for 10 min to give a clear solution. Et3N was added dropwise and stirring continued for 24 h at room temperature. The solution was filtered and evaporated under vacuum to a solid yellow residue. X-ray quality crystals were grown from pyridine/benzene (5:1) with hexane as the diffusing solvent at room temperature in two weeks.
synthesis.time: stir 10 min then 24 h after base addition; crystals in two weeks
synthesis.vessel_or_method: ligand-controlled hydrolysis in methanol; crystallization by hexane diffusion into pyridine/benzene (5:1)
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: filtered, evaporated under vacuum to yellow residue; X-ray quality crystals from pyridine/benzene (5:1) with hexane diffusion at room temperature over two weeks

properties.summary: Dy4 shows field-independent dc susceptibility with χT = 59 cm3 K mol−1 at 300 K (expected ~56 for four Dy(III)), falling to 37 cm3 K mol−1 at low T. Magnetization reaches 22 μB at 2 K and 5 T. Frequency-dependent in-phase and out-of-phase ac susceptibility (10–1500 Hz) indicates slow magnetic relaxation, with the out-of-phase peak near 1.8 K so that relaxation dynamics could not be fully quantified; the cluster is discussed as a possible polynuclear Dy SMM.
